title: Phase space anatomy of dynamical quantum phase transitions
summary: Dynamical quantum phase transitions (DQPT) are commonly defined either by the behavior of a late-time order parameter or by nonanalyticities in a quantum state's return rate. We show that discrete phase space fundamentally separates these two notions by the scale of information they require. An order parameter transition is determined by a local reduced state, requiring no quasiprobability negativity.
